end.parentNote: Asha practised estimating collections with groups of ten and asking whether an estimate is close. Ananya explained that three groups of ten make thirty and recognised that 40 and 43 are close. They once counted the groups as if each group were one object; this was corrected later by identifying three groups as 30 peanuts. At home, show a small collection, make a quick estimate together, then count to check it.
